title: Record Store row (local shape)
description: One row of the records table as a client stores and exchanges it: the cloud row minus the columns a client never reads (scopeId, generationId, state, snapshotJson, minDeltaVersion). The root row of a pool is the row whose objectId equals its poolId. See Plans/Record Store §3.

poolId.description: the pool: the root object's id

objectId.description: the puuid; equals poolId on the root row

parentId.description: owning collection node: a folder for a child pool's root, a windowed collection for its elements; null on the home root and on every core record

orderKey.description: fractional sort key under parentId; null iff parentId is null

version.description: root row only, server-owned: the content sequence, mirrored down

modifiedVersion.description: the pool version that last wrote this row

isDeleted.description: tombstone; true iff payloadJson is null

payloadJson.description: the serialized record, byte-for-byte; null iff isDeleted
